linkedin:
Every new AI session starts from zero. You explain the project again, the decision you made last week, and why.

S3 Brain keeps the decisions, reasons and results of your work in one memory on your Mac, so Claude Code, Codex and your other AI tools pick up exactly where you left off.

What makes it useful is what it keeps apart:
· A proposal: an idea worth remembering, not something you approved
· A decision: your choice, with the reason attached
· An outcome: a reported result, still worth checking against the files

An old idea never gets mistaken for the final call.

Free for personal use, macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
https://s3dat.com/products/s3-brain
